'''Palace Plaza''' was a wide, open avenue which stretched from the grand entrance of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the capital of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and ran down to the massive [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]] further on in the city.

==History==
A long, quiet avenue that served as the main walking plaza at the center of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the Palace Plaza was open to foot traffic only, as was the rest of Theed's city streets after a ban on all personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] was affected under the reign of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]]. Lined on either side by small shops, museums, monuments, and office buildings, the Plaza was trisected at two points by the [[Triumphal Arch/Legends|Triumphal Arch]] and another lesser arch along the length of the avenue.<ref name="TPM" />

A place for celebration and for leisure, the Palace Plaza was occupied by tanks and armies in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] under the leadership of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. Martial law in the city was instituted briefly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|resistance movement]], led by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], turned the Plaza into a battleground. While the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] were victorious and drove Gunray's forces offworld, a major portion of the Plaza was left in ruins. To replace the devastated area, Amidala oversaw the construction of the hemispherical [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]] at the end of the street, containing government offices and serving as an annex to the Palace itself.<ref name="AOTC" />

In the wake of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a bloody conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] touched down on the planet to deliver the body of former queen and senator Padmé Amidala to her adoring people. To honor the beloved ruler and representative, the monarchy arranged a grand [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]], attended by all of Theed and diplomats and colleagues of the senator from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lining the Palace Plaza, the funeral procession moved away from the palace down the avenue past countless onlookers.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> The Plaza would later become a battleground when the 501st Legion arrived to assassinate Queen Apailana, who had been harboring fugitive Jedi. The Plaza was reinforced with an auto-turret grid, though this was disabled by the 501st. The Queen appeared in an attempt to escape, only to be killed by an Imperial sniper just outside the Royal Palace. Following this insurrection, Naboo was subjugated entirely by the Empire.

Following decades of oppression under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the authoritarian government that arose from the ashes of the Clone Wars, the people of Naboo staged an [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|uprising]] after the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and raided the palace, ousting the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and liberating themselves from Imperial rule. Thousands of citizens took to the streets, flooding Palace Plaza and celebrating, shouting from the rooftops their joy.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
